title: Calumet Avenue's walk back inside the full-detail budget
items: Standing on Calumet Avenue's east walk at 20th Street looking north, the 1904 scene at full detail was drawing about 4.7 million triangles, over its 4.6 million budget. Nearly half came from one house the visitor cannot see there: Glessner House, about 290 m off and hidden behind the Calumet houses and their elms. Full detail now leaves out pieces of a building that sit completely behind another building's wall, as Light has done since October, and the same view draws 2.9 million. Nothing a visitor can see is removed: seven of the eight views tested match pixel for pixel, and the eighth differs at three pixels by a barely measurable shade.
